notes.title: Necro Immortallis v1.1.0 update!
notes.content:
Includes a little secret thanks to this wonderful person (Scruncho Gaming https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCTXMqD5Rx56GePToQpzDRfw) who suggested some cool ideas for the game and now you have it!
The old "look at me" is now changed to "click me" and is indeed clickable.

Also a few adjustments so the items would be more visible in the world.

Cheers!

Vidas
